name: GPT Realtime 2.1
short: OpenAI's speech-to-speech conversational model with enhanced alphanumeric acoustic fidelity, low-latency audio turn-taking, and adaptive test-time reasoning.
modalities: Audio, text, image in; audio, text out
standout: Native full-duplex speech reasoning with sharp alphanumeric comprehension for IDs, serials, and dates.
tradeoff: Audio streaming rates exceed pure text processing costs; requires WebSocket/WebRTC audio client infrastructure.
